name: cast_test.k
model:
class IntToRealWidening {
  x:Int = 42
  y:Real = 3.5E0

  req x >= 0

  req y > 0E0

  req x < y * 2E1
}

class RealToIntCast {
  pi:Real = 3.14159E0
  truncated:Int = pi as Int

  req truncated = 3
  negReal:Real = -2.7E0
  negTrunc:Int = negReal as Int

  req negTrunc = -3
}

class BitVecConversions {
  intVal:Int = 255
  bv:BitVec[8] = intVal as BitVec[8]
  backToInt:Int = bv as Int

  req backToInt = 255
}
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((IntToRealWidening (mk-IntToRealWidening (x Int)(y Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((RealToIntCast (mk-RealToIntCast (pi Real)(truncated Int)(negReal Real)(negTrunc Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((BitVecConversions (mk-BitVecConversions (intVal Int)(bv (_ BitVec 8))(backToInt Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-IntToRealWidening (sel-IntToRealWidening IntToRealWidening))
  (lift-RealToIntCast (sel-RealToIntCast RealToIntCast))
  (lift-BitVecConversions (sel-BitVecConversions BitVecConversions))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-IntToRealWidening ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-IntToRealWidening (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-IntToRealWidening ((this Ref)) IntToRealWidening
  (sel-IntToRealWidening (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-RealToIntCast ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-RealToIntCast (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-RealToIntCast ((this Ref)) RealToIntCast
  (sel-RealToIntCast (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-BitVecConversions ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-BitVecConversions (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-BitVecConversions ((this Ref)) BitVecConversions
  (sel-BitVecConversions (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-IntToRealWidening ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-IntToRealWidening this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-RealToIntCast ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-RealToIntCast this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-BitVecConversions ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-BitVecConversions this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ----------------------------------------
;   Getters for class IntToRealWidening:
; ----------------------------------------

; --- getters for IntToRealWidening.x: ---

(define-fun IntToRealWidening!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-IntToRealWidening this))
)

; --- getters for IntToRealWidening.y: ---

(define-fun IntToRealWidening!y ((this Ref)) Real
  (y (deref-IntToRealWidening this))
)

; ------------------------------------
;   Getters for class RealToIntCast:
; ------------------------------------

; --- getters for RealToIntCast.pi: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast!pi ((this Ref)) Real
  (pi (deref-RealToIntCast this))
)

; --- getters for RealToIntCast.truncated: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast!truncated ((this Ref)) Int
  (truncated (deref-RealToIntCast this))
)

; --- getters for RealToIntCast.negReal: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast!negReal ((this Ref)) Real
  (negReal (deref-RealToIntCast this))
)

; --- getters for RealToIntCast.negTrunc: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast!negTrunc ((this Ref)) Int
  (negTrunc (deref-RealToIntCast this))
)

; ----------------------------------------
;   Getters for class BitVecConversions:
; ----------------------------------------

; --- getters for BitVecConversions.intVal: ---

(define-fun BitVecConversions!intVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (intVal (deref-BitVecConversions this))
)

; --- getters for BitVecConversions.bv: ---

(define-fun BitVecConversions!bv ((this Ref)) (_ BitVec 8)
  (bv (deref-BitVecConversions this))
)

; --- getters for BitVecConversions.backToInt: ---

(define-fun BitVecConversions!backToInt ((this Ref)) Int
  (backToInt (deref-BitVecConversions this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class IntToRealWidening:
; ------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-IntToRealWidening IntToRealWidening)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun IntToRealWidening.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (IntToRealWidening!x this) 42)
)

(assert (! (IntToRealWidening.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun IntToRealWidening.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (IntToRealWidening!y this) 3.5000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (IntToRealWidening.inv2 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun IntToRealWidening.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (IntToRealWidening!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (IntToRealWidening.inv3 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun IntToRealWidening.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (IntToRealWidening!y this) 0.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (IntToRealWidening.inv4 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun IntToRealWidening.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (IntToRealWidening!x this) (* (IntToRealWidening!y this) 20.0000000000000000))
)

(assert (! (IntToRealWidening.inv5 1) :named _xkassert4))



; --------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class RealToIntCast:
; --------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-RealToIntCast RealToIntCast)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RealToIntCast!pi this) 3.1415900000000000)
)

(assert (! (RealToIntCast.inv1 2) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RealToIntCast!truncated this) (to_int (RealToIntCast!pi this)))
)

(assert (! (RealToIntCast.inv2 2) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RealToIntCast!negReal this) (- 2.7000000000000000))
)

(assert (! (RealToIntCast.inv3 2) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RealToIntCast!negTrunc this) (to_int (RealToIntCast!negReal this)))
)

(assert (! (RealToIntCast.inv4 2) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RealToIntCast!truncated this) 3)
)

(assert (! (RealToIntCast.inv5 2) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun RealToIntCast.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RealToIntCast!negTrunc this) (- 3))
)

(assert (! (RealToIntCast.inv6 2) :named _xkassert10))



; ------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class BitVecConversions:
; ------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-BitVecConversions BitVecConversions)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun BitVecConversions.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (BitVecConversions!intVal this) 255)
)

(assert (! (BitVecConversions.inv1 3) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun BitVecConversions.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (BitVecConversions!bv this) ((_ int2bv 8) (BitVecConversions!intVal this)))
)

(assert (! (BitVecConversions.inv2 3) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun BitVecConversions.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (BitVecConversions!backToInt this) (bv2int (BitVecConversions!bv this)))
)

(assert (! (BitVecConversions.inv3 3) :named _xkassert13))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun BitVecConversions.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (BitVecConversions!backToInt this) 255)
)

(assert (! (BitVecConversions.inv4 3) :named _xkassert14))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-IntToRealWidening const-1-IntToRealWidening))
        2 (lift-RealToIntCast const-2-RealToIntCast))
        3 (lift-BitVecConversions const-3-BitVecConversions))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-IntToRealWidening () IntToRealWidening
  (mk-IntToRealWidening 42 (/ 7.0 2.0)))
(define-fun const-2-RealToIntCast () RealToIntCast
  (mk-RealToIntCast (/ 314159.0 100000.0) 3 (- (/ 27.0 10.0)) (- 3)))
(define-fun const-3-BitVecConversions () BitVecConversions
  (mk-BitVecConversions 255 #xff 255))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (negReal (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))) (- (/ 27.0 10.0))))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-IntToRealWidening (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (pi (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))) (/ 314159.0 100000.0)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (truncated (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))) 3))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (bv2int (bv (sel-BitVecConversions (select heap 3))))))
  (= (backToInt (sel-BitVecConversions (select heap 3))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (x (sel-IntToRealWidening (select heap 1))) 42))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (to_int (negReal (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))))))
  (= (negTrunc (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (= (negTrunc (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))) (- 3)))
(define-fun _xkassert14 () Bool
  (= (backToInt (sel-BitVecConversions (select heap 3))) 255))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 ((_ int2bv 8) (intVal (sel-BitVecConversions (select heap 3))))))
  (= (bv (sel-BitVecConversions (select heap 3))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (> (y (sel-IntToRealWidening (select heap 1))) 0.0))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (= (intVal (sel-BitVecConversions (select heap 3))) 255))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (to_int (pi (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))))))
  (= (truncated (sel-RealToIntCast (select heap 2))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (y (sel-IntToRealWidening (select heap 1))) (/ 7.0 2.0)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (to_real (x (sel-IntToRealWidening (select heap 1)))))
      (a!2 (* (y (sel-IntToRealWidening (select heap 1))) 20.0)))
  (< a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         1
                         (lift-IntToRealWidening
                           (mk-IntToRealWidening 42 (/ 7.0 2.0))))
                  2
                  (lift-RealToIntCast
                    (mk-RealToIntCast (/ 314159.0 100000.0)
                                      3
                                      (- (/ 27.0 10.0))
                                      (- 3))))))
  (store a!1 3 (lift-BitVecConversions (mk-BitVecConversions 255 #xff 255)))))
